# Neorender FW 1.0.2

Neorender FW 1.0.2 is a targeted Stable bugfix release.

## Fixed

- Saved NFS shares support arbitrary valid export paths and use neutral examples in the Sources form.
- Sources refreshes its authoritative saved-share list immediately after a successful save.
- Player connects the selected saved network share through the same backend flow as Sources and opens selection when no share is unambiguous.
- Player timeline state is bound to the current track and ignores stale status responses during track changes.
- MPD timing profiles include concise neutral explanations.
- GMediaRenderer advertises `Neorender (no MPD)` instead of the legacy friendly name after restart.
- Consumer-facing errors no longer append English backend diagnostics to localized messages.

## Scope

This release does not change the OTA architecture, factory-image pipeline, MPD automatic-update policy, SoundLab, Wi-Fi priority implementation or renderer architecture.
